```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(Cairo)
library(lubridate)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
    ))
```

## Data Loading

```{r}
repos_df <- read_csv("../data/repos_with_details.csv")

reference_date <- as.Date("2025-11-30")

repos_df <- repos_df %>%
    mutate(
        repo_created = ymd_hms(repo_created),
        adoption_yearmonth = agent_adopt_month,
        repo_age_days = as.integer(difftime(reference_date, repo_created, units = "days"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(agent_adopt_month)) %>%
    filter(adoption_yearmonth >= "2024-05", adoption_yearmonth < "2025-08")

agent_first <- read_lines("../data/agent_first.txt") %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    .[. != ""]

ide_first <- read_lines("../data/ide_first.txt") %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    .[. != ""]

repos_agent <- repos_df %>% filter(name %in% agent_first)
repos_ide <- repos_df %>% filter(name %in% ide_first)
```

## Descriptive Statistics Table

```{r}
calc_stats <- function(x) {
    c(
        mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        std_dev = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

metrics <- c(
    "repo_age_days", "stars", "forks", "num_prs", "num_agent_prs"
)

stats_list_agent <- repos_agent %>%
    select(all_of(metrics)) %>%
    map(calc_stats)

stats_list_ide <- repos_ide %>%
    select(all_of(metrics)) %>%
    map(calc_stats)

stats_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Age (days)",
    "Stars",
    "Forks",
    "Pull Requests",
    "Agentic Pull Requests"
  ),
  Mean_Agent = sapply(stats_list_agent, function(x) round(x["mean"], 1)),
  Mean_IDE = sapply(stats_list_ide, function(x) round(x["mean"], 1)),
  Min_Agent = sapply(stats_list_agent, function(x) round(x["min"], 1)),
  Min_IDE = sapply(stats_list_ide, function(x) round(x["min"], 1)),
  Median_Agent = sapply(stats_list_agent, function(x) round(x["median"], 1)),
  Median_IDE = sapply(stats_list_ide, function(x) round(x["median"], 1)),
  Max_Agent = sapply(stats_list_agent, function(x) round(x["max"], 1)),
  Max_IDE = sapply(stats_list_ide, function(x) round(x["max"], 1))
)

cat("\n\n=== LATEX TABLE OUTPUT ===\n\n")
cat(" & AF & IF & AF & IF & AF & IF & AF & IF \\\\\n")
cat("\\midrule\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(stats_df))) {
  row_str <- sprintf("%-22s", stats_df$Metric[i])
  
  for (j in 2:ncol(stats_df)) {
    val <- stats_df[i, j]
    if (val == floor(val)) {
      row_str <- paste0(row_str, " & ", as.integer(val))
    } else {
      row_str <- paste0(row_str, " & ", val)
    }
  }
  
  cat(row_str, " \\\\\n", sep="")
}

cat("\\bottomrule\n")
cat("\n=== END LATEX TABLE ===\n\n")
```
